stem:
Rohit grows a bean plant in a pot on the balcony. He records these stages: seed, germination, young plant with leaves, flowers, then pods with seeds. Some pods turn yellow and dry.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The order is seed → germination → leaves → flowers → pods with seeds, and seeds in a pod can grow into a new bean plant.
New bean seeds form inside the leaves.
The order is seed → germination → leaves → pods → flowers.
The cycle is complete at seed → germination → leaves → flowers.

teacher.key_rationale: Bean life cycle runs seed to germination, leaves, flowers, then pods with seeds that can start a new generation. Seeds do not form in leaves; pods do not come before flowers; stopping at flowers leaves the cycle incomplete.
